repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T03:42Z · On the seat's decision card 「头像菜单的语言要不要和登录页一样列全部 11 种?」 (should the avatar menu list all 11 interface languages, like the sign-in page?), the maintainer chose 「两处都列全部 11 种」 (option A of three) at 2026-11-21T03:39:49Z. The other two options were 「两处都按应用语言收窄」 (narrow both to the app's declared languages) and 「清单不变,只补当前语言」 (keep both lists, only add the current language to the menu).

Recorded meaning (the card's "要做的" item 1; item 2 is dropped):
- The sign-in page and the avatar menu offer the same list: every interface language the console ships (the platform locale table, 11 today).
- A language the app has no translation for stays selectable. The interface chrome shows in that language; business objects, field names and views fall back to the deployment's default language. The menu marks such languages with one short line, 「应用内容显示为默认语言」 (wording may be polished, but it says "default language", not "English").
- A language picked on the sign-in page is found, checked and selectable again in the menu after sign-in.
- Frontend only: `/api/v1/i18n/locales` is unchanged and no language pack is added. The profile page's language card uses the same list; the organisation default-language setting keeps the app's declared list.
- This loosens the 2026-11-02 ruling F on #29349 (one tier, no menu hint) that #30514 implemented. The menu hint F rejected is now wanted.

The work goes to area b1-CX; the PR carries `Fixes #35425`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: card thread · 2026-11-21T09:45Z · b1-CX thread 5, running in parallel with thread 4 (#35415; different files).
Area: b1-CX
Session: `session_01L6bhgTB7jMdUGcVwaMo3CH` (card thread, dev-thread rule)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-2egdok
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/i18n/src/provider.tsx`; `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (one new key in the ten hand-written packs, zh-Hant generated); `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocaleSwitcher.tsx`; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useUserLocale.ts` (maybe comments only); `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx`; the tests that pin the intersection today (`LocaleSwitcher.appLocales`, `provider-app-locale-restore`, `ProfilePage.language`); a changeset for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`.
Container & model: `M`, own card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (expected; widening: the `@object-ui/i18n` context gains an `appContentLanguages` field and one i18n key is added). The seat runs the declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT`.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, main `fe753492`): holds. The avatar menu and the sign-in page are one component, `LocaleSwitcher`, and both read the provider's `offerableLanguages` (the platform table intersected with the app's `/api/v1/i18n/locales`). Signed out, the app list is not fetched, so the sign-in page falls back to all 11; signed in, the list narrows to the app's 4. The profile page's language card reads the same value.
Basis: card #35425 (epic #34571); the maintainer's ruling 7056785432 (option A: both places list all 11 interface languages, with a note).
Scope, the seat's reading:
1. `offerableLanguages` is always the platform table (11 today). A new `appContentLanguages` gives the table languages the app's list covers, or null when unknown. Self-heal still judges by the table, so a code outside it (for example `th`) still falls back.
2. The menu lists all 11. When the app list is known and does not cover a language, its row carries one short line, 「应用内容显示为默认语言」 (says "default language", not "English", per the ruling). Signed out, the app list is unknown, so the sign-in page lists the 11 without the line.
3. The profile page's language card uses the same 11 and shows the same line under the picker when the chosen language has no app content. The organisation default-language setting keeps the app's declared list and is not touched.
4. A language picked on the sign-in page is found, checked and selectable again after sign-in. `/api/v1/i18n/locales` is unchanged and no language pack is added.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. `overlap-check.mjs` is clean now and runs before each push. L1 at L1-a. The PR carries `Fixes #35425`. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.
